correctness.rationale: An SHF of type {2,2} forbids a four-column subset with some 2+2 partition whose symbol images overlap in all three rows. Independent combinatorial enumeration of every 4-subset of 27 ternary length-three words found 16,092 forbidden four-subsets, then exhaustively checked all C(27,5)=80,730 and C(27,6)=296,010 candidate families, obtaining exactly 54 valid 5-sets and 0 valid 6-sets. For each maximum, each coordinate has multiplicities (2,2,1) and the three unique-symbol positions coincide; deleting that word leaves a binary even/odd parity class of four 3-bit words. The canonical set {000,011,101,110,222} is separating; with three independent symbol permutations per row and row permutations the natural group has 6³×6=1296 elements. Its orbit has 54 sets, hence one orbit and stabilizer order 1296/54=24. The Hamming distance multiset is 6 pairs at distance2 and 4 at distance3. These computations enumerate every finite case, not samples or a claim about other parameters; the known n≤5 upper bound was checked against Bazrafshan 2011 Prop.5.2.3.
